name: magician
description: Skills and agents for the software lifecycle in Claude Code: research, design, planning, test-first building, code review, security checks and release. Includes a local code index, per-project workspace notes, stack-specific guidance at session start, and optional Jira and Confluence access.

jira_base_url.title: Jira base URL
jira_base_url.description: Optional. https://<site>.atlassian.net for Jira Cloud, or your Jira Server/Data Center URL. Leave empty if you don't use Jira.

jira_email.title: Jira account email (Cloud only)
jira_email.description: Jira Cloud only (Basic auth, REST v3). Leave empty for Jira Server/Data Center, which uses the token alone (Bearer, REST v2).

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token or personal access token
jira_api_token.description: Cloud: an API token from id.atlassian.com. Server/Data Center: a personal access token. Kept in your system's secure credential store, never in settings.json.

confluence_base_url.title: Confluence base URL
confluence_base_url.description: Optional. Cloud: https://<site>.atlassian.net/wiki (include /wiki). Server/Data Center: your Confluence URL plus any context path. Leave empty if you don't use Confluence.

confluence_email.title: Confluence account email (Cloud only)
confluence_email.description: Confluence Cloud only (Basic auth). Leave empty for Server/Data Center (Bearer token).

confluence_api_token.title: Confluence API token or personal access token
confluence_api_token.description: Cloud: the same Atlassian API token works for Jira and Confluence on one site. Server/Data Center: a Confluence personal access token. Kept in your secure credential store.

auto_format.title: Auto-format files Claude edits
auto_format.description: After Claude writes or edits a file, run ruff (or black), gofmt, rustfmt or shfmt if already installed on your PATH, and tell Claude the file changed. Off by default.

auto_format_prettier.title: Also run prettier (JS/TS/JSON/CSS/HTML/Markdown)
auto_format_prettier.description: Only applies when auto-format is on. prettier loads the project's own config and plugins, which can run code from the repository. Off by default.

desktop_notifications.title: Notify when a background session finishes or needs input
desktop_notifications.description: Asks your terminal to show a notification when a background session finishes or needs input; terminals without notification support show none. Off by default.

session_history.title: Keep a local session history
session_history.description: Keep a short local record of each session (branch, commit count, changed file names). On by default.
